sub_indicators.label: Data centres for hire in service
sub_indicators.subject: infra.store
sub_indicators.text: Local data centre capacity (all providers): data centres for hire in service
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Smart Africa Data Center and Cloud Blueprint asks every country for data centres built to recognised tiers, so that content and data can be hosted in Africa.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no data centre in the country rents space or computing to others.
A data centre in the country rents space, power or computing to other organisations.
One such data centre is Tier III or above.
Two or more such data centres are Tier III or above.
A global cloud provider sells its services from a cloud region in the country.

aspects.name: In service, Tier III, and two of them
